checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Screen displays operating system interface with icons and text.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Weight is light enough for comfortable one-handed operation.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Inferred from the casual grip and lack of strain indicators on the hands/fingers.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Battery-powered computer small enough for pocket carriage.

Skin texture appears somewhat smudged and lacks fine pore detail, likely due to low resolution or compression, but borders between fingers are mostly distinct.
Text on the screen is illegible/pixelated blobs rather than sharp characters, common in low-res images or AI generations struggling with small text.
